episodes.title: I escaped from a Mormon cult
episodes.description:
In today's video I vent about how I escaped a Mormon cult that still tries to suck me back in everywhere I go around town. Barf. To offset such a gloomy topic, I take breaks throughout to sing. 

Come sing and chill with me while I tell you all about escaping from the Mormon cult in my hometown, staying OUT of the cult as an adult, and listen as I work on covers from Kpop Demon Hunters and Kehlani. ❤️‍🔥
